# Test fixture: the `cursor` layout

A small, synthetic collection in the layout of https://cursor.com/docs/context/rules (`.cursor/rules/*.mdc`), read on 2026-09-23. Every
skill and rule here was written for the tests of `import --from skills` and
`export --to skills` (CONN-2); none is copied from a real collection. The fixture
text is CC0-1.0 unless a file in it states a licence of its own — those statements
are part of what the tests read.
